page.title: Models
page.failureTail: Nothing moved — the registry is back as it was.
page.summaryProxyOff: <endpoints/> endpoints · <keys/> Spend keys · proxy <proxy/>, nothing metered

proxy.note: A thin optional hop in front of the upstreams. It is what issues a spend key, holds it to a budget, meters a run and pulls a key when its lease ends — so its switch decides whether the three sections below are configuration or enforcement.
proxy.sentenceOn: Spend keys are checked, budgets are enforced and every run is metered
proxy.sentenceOff: workers get a url and a key injected directly — Spend keys are not checked, budgets are not enforced and nothing is metered
proxy.immutableSentence: virtual keys are seeded from configuration and immutable at runtime — spend is metered at the proxy, not reported here
proxy.burnLabel: Spend by hour across the metered day, peak {{peak}} at {{hour}}.
proxy.offConfirmBody: Workers get a url and a key injected directly. Spend keys stop being checked, every budget below stops being enforced, and no run is metered until it is turned back on.

endpoints.note: Two wires, openai-compatible and anthropic-compatible, and nothing else. Workers take a url and a key through their provider config; the lead and chat take the same endpoints through a chat client. A self-hosted url is an ordinary row.
endpoints.emptyFiltered: no endpoints match the current filters

keys.note: A key carries its own route, cap, model list, scope and TTL — so a leaked one buys a single endpoint, the models named on it, what is left of a budget, until a day the holder does not control. The secret is shown once when it is issued and never again.
keys.noteUnenforced: With the proxy off none of it is being checked.
keys.emptyFiltered: no keys match the current filters
keys.empty: no spend key has been issued
keys.revokeConfirmBody: {{prefix}} · {{label}} — the key stops working immediately and cannot be brought back. A worker holding it loses it with its lease, mid-run.
keys.revokeRestartNote: The key store is seeded from configuration — a host restart resurrects this key until its Proxy:VirtualKeys row is removed.

routing.note: The platform speaks in roles, never in vendors: the lead plans, writes contracts, reviews results and repairs a failed run; the worker runs profile steps in a container. This is where a role becomes a physical model, and the only place that mapping exists.
routing.emptyFiltered: no roles match the current filters
routing.empty: no role has been routed to a model

sheet.alreadyStopped: this key has already stopped — there is nothing to revoke
sheet.reading: {{total}} over the last {{days}} days · {{average}} a day · heaviest {{day}} at {{peak}}
sheet.silentDays: · no spend recorded in the last {{count}} days

meter.noCapTitle: this key carries no cap — it spends until it is revoked or expires
meter.notMeteredHereTitle: the cap is live but this surface does not meter spend
meter.unforcedTitle: the proxy is off — this cap is recorded but not applied
